agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: IL13Ralpha2-CAR T cells may better recognize and destroy brain tumor cells

source_quote.quote: Participant has a histologically confirmed IL13Ralpha2+ tumor expression by immunohistochemistry (IHC) at the initial tumor presentation or recurrent disease (H-score \>= 50)

coder_notes: Only intervention is a CAR T-cell therapy (excluded type), so no pharmacological candidate. IL13Ralpha2 eligibility biomarker matches the CAR T target but CAR T is not a candidate, hence candidate_matched false. Population includes glioblastoma plus ependymoma and medulloblastoma (leptomeningeal disease); medulloblastoma is not a glioma, so 'mixed_glioma_gbm_named' is the nearest category. IL13Ralpha2 antigen on tumour tissue pre/post therapy is also a secondary outcome. Steroids and tocilizumab mentioned only in eligibility, not listed.
